CustomField.description: NET set. Derived, not stored: a renewal restates the book so Net equals Current; every other action type is Current plus Existing.
CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(OriginalActionType) = "Renew", NULLVALUE(Current_MRR_Infra__c, 0) - NULLVALUE(Existing_MRR_Infra__c, 0), NULLVALUE(Current_MRR_Infra__c, 0) + NULLVALUE(Existing_MRR_Infra__c, 0) )
CustomField.label: Net MRR - Infra
